user_scope: One additional deepening round and one additional EDA/statistical round before further model development. Stop all GitHub uploads until the user explicitly resumes them.
question: Which prior mechanisms survive broader chain-level diagnostics, which apparent effects are sampling/representation artifacts, and what evidence is still missing before new training?
round_1: Independent attacks on the assumptions, identification, statistical units and controls of training, event memory/clock and quant flow proposals; freeze diagnostic plans before outcomes.
round_2: Execute bounded CPU EDA and statistical studies with complete results and cross-review; no new forecasting-model training or candidate tuning.

baseline.OOF_reference: one-epoch C: ft256dH+ft128H+ft128s4H+ftc500H, equal raw weights, folds0/1; distinguish from V1

analyses: broader head-gradient geometry across saved parents/stages and fixed windows
fixed C OOF metric-mass, dependence and analytic member-scale sensitivity
chain-stable binary event-clock agreement and event-stream EDA
causal trade-mark predictability versus adaptive-frequency controls and order-destroying surrogates

statistics.unit: whole chain, with fold/market strata explicit; never count dependent rows as independent replicates
statistics.exposure: All supplied data previously exposed; disjoint diagnostic halves and excluded prior samples do not create fresh confirmation
statistics.uncertainty: conditional chain resampling for fixed artifacts; separate across-parent/seed summaries; no claim of training or unseen-test superiority
statistics.multiple_looks: Freeze all planned readouts/slices and report all, with no winner-only posthoc significance. Exploratory intervals are descriptive and not selection-corrected.

allowed: read local and beleriand original artifacts/data
write new code/results in isolated creative worktrees
CPU nuisance/statistical fits specified before outcomes
local git commits and direct SSH file sync only
registration: Each analysis freezes sample rule, source identities, recipe, estimands, denominators, slices, checks and timeout handling in its own plan before execution. Baseline sensitivities are analytic at the fixed mixture; no coefficient sweep or new ensemble scoring.
invariants: No GitHub push, PR or external artifact upload
No mutation of original dirty server checkout, saved checkpoints, scorer or past results
No use of label-derived class at inference
No full-sequence centering or future values in causal trade predictors
Record failed executions without hiding retries; execution fixes must retain the fixed scientific recipe
stop: Complete the four fixed analyses and independent reviews, then synthesize a local report and next evidence requirements. No automatic neural training or expansion after interesting slices.
